method: Parsed the uploaded RouterOS RSC, normalized CIDRs to IPv4 intervals, derived candidate exclusive address space by subtracting the other operator's candidate ranges, then computed exact address-space intersections and differences. No baseline prefixes or raw production entries are included in this report.
interpretation_and_limits: Both candidate sources cover nearly all of their own exclusive address space already present in the old production lists.
The old production CT list contains a materially larger address space than either candidate; the old production CMCC list is roughly four times the size of either candidate's exclusive CMCC space.
This comparison measures address-space similarity only. It cannot determine which source correctly classifies an IP as CT or CMCC.

The extra baseline-only ranges may be deliberate historical policy, stale allocations, other classifications, or a consequence of differing source methodology. They must not be deleted without classification review.
Candidate-only ranges are also not proof of correctness; they are simply ranges present in a candidate and absent from the old list.
No production RouterOS data was changed. The uploaded baseline file itself is not copied into this public repository.
